description: ONE complete ORIGINAL Rune Sentinel male BASE outfit sheet, ALL12 frames designed TOGETHER from the FOUR complete reference sheets. Output EXACT96x128, grid3 columns x4 rows, every cell32x32. Columns idle/walk1/walk2. Rows N/back, E/right, S/front, W/left; EVERY frame in each row keeps its heading, including ALL west walk frames. Match the EXACT TIBIA8.6 projection and anatomy in Citizen reference1: compact roughly32x32 human, head UPPER-LEFT of feet and whole body extending diagonally LOWER-RIGHT in ALL facings. This diagonal body axis is the fixed oblique camera, not a facing direction. NOT upright front/side RPG humans, not tall64px actors. Copy all12 native head/face/hands, arm/leg bends, foot poses and square proportions. Fit each complete figure in its32px slot, no crossing rows. NEW exclusive rune-order elite guard clothing over that anatomy: fitted open-face angular steel helm, crafted plate cuirass with ONE inset diamond runestone, short layered hip armor/belt, fitted bracers, dark cloth joints, paired matching knee/greave plates and armored boots. Broad coherent steel planes, deliberate silhouette and repeated angular cuts throughout, not recolored Citizen or noisy wrinkles. Same outfit/attachments/materials in every angle and phase; chest stone stays FRONT and is hidden on back. Use the full Knight/Nightmare/Brotherhood sheets to understand real Tibia craft, turning and walking. Neutral WHITE/GRAY/CHARCOAL COSTUME including stone, natural skin ONLY on actual face/hands. Upper-left light, clean native pixels, transparent background. Base stands alone; crest and enlarged ornate shoulder addons come later. No copied outfit, extra limb, weapon, shield, cape, banner, text, grid lines, particles or blur.
